# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 9 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1..level-8 martial chassis baseline to level 9 as chosen input only.
# It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus
# and bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/skill/equipment posture
# from the level-1 through level-8 fixtures, adding only the level bump this
# bounded tranche needs. The level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist)
# is carried forward unchanged — PF1 also grants monks SEPARATE bonus feats
# at 2nd and 6th level, but this slice deliberately does not add a new
# choice-slot for either (it stays named but unproven, unchanged by this
# widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of
# what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2/level-6 bonus
# feat grant recognition, no ki-power execution (extra attack, AC bonus, or
# speed bonus), no fall-damage engine, no High Jump, no Wholeness of Body
# execution, and no level-10+ progression. The PF1 CRB Monk class table's
# level-9 "Special" column reads "Improved evasion" (verified independently
# against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) — an upgrade of the
# already-recognized 2nd-level Evasion identity, grounded by this slice as a
# +0 identity/recognition record only (no Reflex-save damage-resolution
# engine exists in this codebase), mirroring exactly how Evasion itself and
# the Rogue's Improved Uncanny Dodge were grounded.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level9
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:9
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:deflect_arrows
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
